overview_description.description: Beehive is a peer-to-peer (P2P) lending platform that uses cutting-edge technology to connect businesses looking for quick, low-cost financing with investors who can help fund their expansion. Beehive removes the cost and complexity of traditional finance and replaces it with an effective, simplified fundraising method. The platform allows global investors to earn great returns by investing directly in robust, creditworthy firms.

about_short_description.short_description: Beehive is a UAE-based fintech and digital SME financing platform.

product.name: Term Finance
product.description: Medium-term business financing for established SMEs, intended for one-off investments such as equipment purchases, expansion, and other growth projects.

product.name: Working Capital Finance
product.description: Short-term financing that helps SMEs manage cash-flow gaps, fund operating expenses, and cover timing differences between payments and receipts.

product.name: Beehive SME Investment Platform
product.description: A digital peer-to-peer investment platform that connects investors with SME financing opportunities and supports portfolio allocation by product mix, business exposure, and risk rating.

product.name: SME Credit and Risk Assessment
product.description: A digital and analyst-led underwriting service that evaluates SME repayment capacity, ownership, financial data, alternative data, and operational conditions before funding is listed.

product.name: Capital Guarantee Business Funding
product.description: A guaranteed SME financing scheme delivered with Dubai SME for Dubai-based businesses owned or managed by Emiratis that meet specified financial and operational criteria.

product.name: Microfinance
product.description: Small-business financing for fast cash injections, using fixed repayments to address relatively modest funding needs.
